Selected southern survey vāsa/vācal/bāsa/vātil/bādal/bāgalu and Kota vāl preserve the documented lateral, dental and sibilant variants and lect contractions. Full doorway-step compounds are kept separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1931 gives Tamil cem-/civa- red with past -nt-, Malayalam cem-/covva/cuvappu/cōppu red, and Kannada kempu. These selected southern covatta/cuvanda/cem-/cemappu-type survey responses preserve the documented colour family with lect vowels, nasal/labial developments and ordinary adjective endings. Kannada c-initial loan-looking forms are excluded from this group. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1404 gives Tamil kaṉa be heavy and kaṉam heaviness, Malayalam kanam/kanakka heavy. These simple kana/kanam/ganama and ordinary kanamānatɨ heavy responses match that weight family. DEDR explicitly says the family is influenced by Sanskrit ghana; the proposal retains that contact caveat and does not claim an uncontaminated inherited history. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
